name: 21202 · Baltimore, MD
findings: ZIP 21202 (Baltimore) has 364 nonprofit organizations. 145 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 126 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21202 (Baltimore) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 21202 (Baltimore) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 126 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
